name: Sheenlac Opulence Exterior Polyurethane Clear Finish (Matt / Satin)
shortDescription: Sophisticated low-sheen matt exterior 2-pack polyurethane clear coat providing tough UV, scratch, and moisture resistance on modern exterior architectural woodwork.
overview: Sheenlac Opulence Exterior Polyurethane Matt offers the same uncompromising weather defense as its gloss counterpart while delivering a modern, non-reflective satin/matt aesthetic. Formulated with treated micro-matting silica particles suspended in an aliphatic polyurethane matrix, it diffuses light uniformly without clouding the warmth and depth of natural timber grain. It shields exterior wood surfaces from blistering UV rays, acid rain, and fungal discoloration, while offering superior scratch and scuff resistance.
keyFeatures: Understated, elegant modern matt finish with uniform low sheen reflection
Advanced aliphatic polyurethane resin formulation guaranteed against yellowing
Incorporates micro-treated matting agents that preserve natural timber grain clarity
Superior resistance against water absorption, surface cracking, and fungal spores
Flexible elastomeric matrix flexes with seasonal expansion of outdoor timber
Resists abrasions, footprints, and scuff marks on decking and handrails
Easy application via pneumatic spray equipment or fine synthetic bristle brushes

specifications.Drying Time: Surface Dry: 1 Hour | Recoat: 6 Hours | Hard Dry: 24 Hours

applications: Contemporary architectural exterior wood cladding and louvers
Resort wooden pavilions, poolside decking, and outdoor dining furniture
Premium villa exterior teakwood main entrance doors
Architectural textured metal panelling requiring clear matte sealing
packageContents: 1x Sheenlac Opulence Exterior PU Matt Base
